review.text:
No actionable regressions found in the reviewed changes. **Score: 9/10.**

- All **19 offline tests passed**.
- Packet creation retains errored calls, rejects incomplete traces, and binds additional Message/archived records to the verified checkpoint.
- Unexpected helpers disqualify usage completeness and pair eligibility.
- All 12 historical attempt objects remain identical to the previous reviewed head; the screening archive is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- The receipt lists all four historical R7 coverage limitations across both arms.
- Accounting preserves the 108 allocation, reduces future requested capacity from 48 to 40, and leaves actual request/token usage unknown.

Coverage gap: I inspected the committed validation receipt but did not independently regenerate the 12 future packets. No live calls or repository changes occurred.

Runtime: T3 Code → Codex harness, **gpt-6.1-sol**, high reasoning. Actual model-request and token usage: **unknown**. Four grouped tool rounds used.

Process deviation: earlier tool outputs exceeded your size bound, and one was truncated; this limits the review’s evidence coverage.
